verdict.rationale: Pulley docs confirm cap tables can be downloaded as Excel 'as of a specific date or for all time' (pulley-docs-18), and Excel is treated as the source of truth during migration (pulley-docs-1/14), supporting open-format export of the cap table. However, there is no explicit evidence of exporting full transaction history or CSV format, nor independent confirmation that data is never held hostage. Missing for 10: explicit transaction-history export documentation, CSV format support, and third-party/independent verification of unrestricted export access.
